_note: Champions League team news kept by the cloud team-news routine. clubs: {"Arsenal": {"out": [], "doubt": [], "note": "reason + sources", "checked": "ISO UTC"}}, club names exactly as on data/ucl/board.json. SHOWN on match cards, not modelled. Ignored after 8 days.

Arsenal.note: Tzolis (hamstring) and Havertz (thigh), both picked up on international duty; Saliba out since July with a back injury (extended layoff, still listed absent as of Oct 5). Hincapie hurt his ankle during post-match warm-down after the 2-1 Leeds win (10 Oct); no official diagnosis but multiple reports say he is unlikely to be available in the short term, putting the Lille match in doubt. Sources: Sports Mole injury list, lastwordonsports.com (6 Oct), arseblog.news, khelnow.com (12 Oct), dailyafc.com; Hincapie corroborated by Sports Mole (multiple pieces), roundtable.io, capitalfm.africa, si.com, dailycannon.com (11-12 Oct). A single khelnow report also claims a fresh ankle injury to Zubimendi (12 Oct) but this remains uncorroborated elsewhere -- not added.

Lille.note: No corroborated current injury news found for the Arsenal fixture; a Squawka preview reports no fresh fitness concerns. An Haraldsson foot injury item appears to date from 2025, not confirmed current.

Atletico Madrid.note: No current (October) injury reports found for the Manchester United fixture with two-source confirmation; most recent corroborated items (Alvarez, Barrios, Sorloth) are from August/September and likely stale by Oct 13.

Manchester United.note: Second shin injury, no return timeline. Sources: ESPN ("No timeline for Sesko return, Carrick says"), Yardbarker, 3addedminutes.com (all ~10 Oct). A Dorgu hamstring mention in one source traced back to an old Jan 2026 injury already recovered from -- not added as current.

Inter.note: No current, corroborated injury news found for the Club Brugge fixture; search results returned only stale/older items.

Club Brugge KV.note: Foot/metatarsal injury, return date not set. Sources: readastonvilla.com, sportsdunia.com club injury list.

Villarreal.note: No corroborated current injury news found for the Napoli fixture.

Napoli.note: Right knee (meniscus) surgery in July, ~3-month recovery; still listed out for the Villarreal fixture by a dedicated match-availability preview. Sources: beinsports.com (surgery confirmation, 20 Jul), starting11.com match preview (current availability list).

Viking.note: A single-source list (tips.gg) names several reported absentees (Berisha, Baertelsen, Roseth, Bjorshol injured; Frimpong suspended) but none is independently corroborated -- not added.

Bayern München.note: Musiala still recovering from a torn thigh muscle fiber, not in full training (Rotowire, tips.gg). Neuer unlikely to start with a foot issue, Urbig set to start in goal (Rotowire, bavarianfootballworks.com).

RB Leipzig.note: Guiu: left hamstring injury confirmed by the club 18 Sep, out for several weeks (ms-aktuell.de, corroborated across multiple match previews). Ouedraogo: shoulder injury recurred after his comeback and required a new operation (90min.de, qatar-tribune.com). Baumgartner: thigh injury, listed out for the PSV fixture (starting11.com fixture page) and separately reported unavailable through injury in a 29-30 Sep squad-depth report (roundtable.io). Reitz: muscle/hamstring issue, listed doubtful for this fixture (starting11.com); a Sportsdunia injury-tracker entry puts his hamstring injury window at 3 Sep-9 Oct, consistent with a borderline return. Abdoul Kone and Leopold Zingerle appear on one tracker (sportsdunia.com) with an unexplained '3 Sep 2026-28 Jan 2027' eligibility/absence flag, but Kone's only sourced injury (a July shoulder problem, getfootballnewsgermany.com) should have resolved months ago and no second source confirms either as currently out -- not added, flagged as unverified.

PSV Eindhoven.note: Plea: ruled out for the rest of 2026 after knee/cartilage surgery (flashscore.com, roundtable.io, coach Bosz quoted by Eindhovens Dagblad). Sildillia: sidelined for several more weeks per the same 2 Oct report, also flagged as a long-term absentee by independent match previews. Wanner: foot injury from Austria duty, out several weeks (roundtable.io 29 Sep, starting11.com). Pepi: out several weeks after a knock vs FC Twente (roundtable.io 2 Oct, starting11.com). Ouaissa: ankle problem, still building back to full training (roundtable.io, starting11.com). Lammers: short of full match fitness (roundtable.io, starting11.com) -- per Flashscore, PSV currently have no fit senior striker. Schouten: long-term knee issue, not expected back until 2027 (roundtable.io 3 Oct, starting11.com). Geertruida: minor knock from Netherlands duty, doubtful not ruled out (roundtable.io 26 Sep, starting11.com).

Galatasaray.note: Victor Osimhen returned from his adductor strain and scored twice against Kasimpasa in his comeback; treated as available, not flagged. Sources: cryptobriefing.com, panafricafootball.com.

Barcelona.note: Raphinha: hamstring/thigh issue from Brazil duty, targeted return 17-20 Oct. de Jong: knee injury (MCL), conservative treatment. Christensen: thigh injury from the Sevilla match. Bardghji: cruciate ligament. Sources: ESPN, Sports Mole, Yahoo Sports, getfootballnewsspain.com, barcauniversal.com, turkiyetoday.com -- all consistent that Flick's squad for Galatasaray (13 Oct) is missing this group.

Sabah FA.note: Squawka's match-specific preview for this 20 Oct Dortmund tie reports no fresh fitness concerns for Sabah; single-sourced, no corroborating second source found for any absence, so nothing added.

Slavia Praha.note: Two independent fixture-specific previews (Squawka and Starting11.com, both for this 20 Oct Fenerbahçe tie) report no outs or suspensions for Slavia. Earlier Rotowire-sourced doubts from the September Lens opener (Tomas Holes, David Zima concussion, David Moses) are not corroborated for this match, so treated as resolved rather than carried forward. Slavia lost 0-2 away at Sabah on 13 Oct (Squawka).

Lens.note: No fresh fitness concerns reported for the Sporting CP fixture (Squawka preview).

Sporting CP.note: No fresh fitness concerns reported for the Lens fixture (Squawka preview).

Lask Linz.note: No corroborated current injury/suspension news for the Liverpool fixture. A single tracker (sportsdunia) lists Ramiz Harakate out long-term (cruciate) and a weekend-loss preview flagged Moses Usor/George Bello as knocked up, but a separate predicted-XI piece still starts Bello -- conflicting, not added.

Liverpool.note: Manager Andoni Iraola said it is highly unlikely Isak (thigh), Gakpo (ankle) and Szoboszlai (hamstring/fatigue after internationals) will be fit for LASK; all three also missed the weekend 0-3 loss to Man City. Ekitike (Achilles rupture, April surgery, 9-12 month recovery window) remains out; Bradley (knee ligament/bone surgery, no timeline given) and Leoni (ACL surgery since Sep 2025, return to full training still unclear) are long-term absences with no indication either has returned. Sources: Sports Mole (Iraola presser), 3AddedMinutes, roundtable.io (28 Sep-14 Oct); goal.com LASK preview (names all five as unavailable); liverpoolfc.com/anfieldindex (Ekitike surgery/recovery); SI.com/goal.com/Irish Examiner (Bradley, Leoni).

Feyenoord.note: Bos: knee injury from World Cup duty, club-confirmed ~3 months out, re-verified today. Other names on a single Como-fixture preview (Watanabe, Nieuwkoop, Moder) are contradicted by a same-day Squawka preview reporting no fresh concerns -- not added.

Como.note: No current (Oct 2026) injury news tied to this fixture for Paz, Baturina or Douvikas; the only located items are stale (a May 2026 Paz knee mention, a Jan/Feb 2026 Douvikas ankle knock).

AS Roma.note: Svilar: stress fracture (reports differ on fifth metacarpal vs. finger/toe), out at least a month per Gasperini -- ruled out for Como and this Real Madrid match, Gollini deputising. Cristante: right knee inflammation (distinct from his earlier back issue), Gasperini says it will cost him games including this one. Sources: Gasperini press conference, allfootballapp, fantacalcio.it, lapresse.it (10 Oct).

Real Madrid.note: Asencio: surgery on a right tibia stress fracture, up to 4 months out. Militao and Mendy are back training but not match-ready -- Sports Mole's Oct 14 (match-day) roundup lists Militao's return as late October and says Mendy has no return date set and was left out of the Villarreal squad; a separate 'welcome back' piece about their return to training does not claim either is available for Roma. Rodrygo: long-term knee injury, not expected back until early 2027. Konate also appears on one preview (Africa Soccer) but is not corroborated by a second source -- not added. Sources: Sports Mole injury/suspension list (dated 14 Oct), Africa Soccer Roma-Real Madrid preview and 'welcome back' piece.

Aston Villa.note: Onana: ACL tear on Belgium World Cup duty (6-7 Jul), surgery in Lyon, ~6-9 month recovery -- still out. Maatsen: ankle/tendon injury since 12 Sep vs Nottingham Forest, expected back late November. Sources: beIN Sports/NST/myjoyonline (Onana); ReadAstonVilla, 3AddedMinutes, bet365 News (Maatsen). Ruggeri (hamstring, forced off vs Brentford) remains unresolved -- Emery said his post-test status would be clearer but no update found; still single-sourced where mentioned, not added. Goretzka's availability is directly contradicted between sources; a Hemmings minor-knock claim (missed Brentford, may return for this match) is single-sourced; Barkley/McGinn claims trace back to an unrelated Jan 2026 Europa League trip -- none added.

Fenerbahçe.note: Two independent fixture-specific previews (Squawka and Starting11.com, both for this 20 Oct Slavia Praha tie) report no outs or suspensions for Fenerbahçe. Earlier single-sourced items (Asensio thigh, Oosterwolde Achilles, Diouf fitness) tied to an earlier/unrelated fixture remain uncorroborated for this match.

Bodo/Glimt.note: No corroborated current injury/suspension news. FotMob lists Brynhildsen and Saltnes unavailable and a Sports Mole preview flags a centre-back gap and Helmersen's return, but each is single-sourced -- not added. Re-checked: a Khel Now preview (13 Oct) names Magnus Bech Riisnaes, Hakon Evjen and August Mikkelsen unfit -- also single-sourced, not added.

Borussia Dortmund.note: Can: ACL tear (28 Feb 2026) plus a further adductor operation confirmed by the club 6 Oct -- out for the rest of 2026, still the case for this Sabah tie (getfootballnewsgermany, Ground News roundup citing the club). Ryerson: rib injury reported 13 Oct (allfootballapp/BVB Buzz, Solbakken quote) remains unresolved either way this cycle -- no second source found to confirm a return, kept as doubt rather than dropped. Re-checked 19 Oct, Squawka's fixture-specific preview flags no fresh concerns beyond these two.

Manchester City.note: Cherki: Guardiola said in early September he would be out roughly 7-8 weeks, covering City's opening Champions League group games -- an official club statement, though not re-confirmed specifically for this PSG match. A Foden-suspended claim surfaced but was internally inconsistent and uncorroborated on a second search -- not added. O'Reilly withdrew from England duty with an unspecified minor issue (single source) -- not added. Re-checked: search results returned only historical (2021, Jan 2025) City-PSG coverage, nothing dated for this fixture.

Paris Saint Germain.note: No current (Oct 2026) injury or lineup news found for this fixture; the only retrievable Dembele/Doue items are dated Sep-Oct 2025, a year stale. Re-checked, same result.

Real Betis.note: Antony left the Osasuna league match (11 Oct) with muscle soreness and underwent medical tests; his availability for both the Barcelona league game and this Porto fixture was reported as unresolved pending those results, with no official return/sit-out update found since. Sources: comuniate.com, worldsoccertalk.com (both 11-13 Oct). Firpo (groin, picked up on Dominican Republic duty) and Ruibal (long-term knee) remain single-sourced (SoccerNews/Scores24 and Khel Now respectively) -- not added.

FC Porto.note: Bednarek served a 2-match European suspension (red card vs Man City) and is now reported RETURNING for this match by two independent previews (abola.pt, Rotowire); one conflicting single source still has him suspended -- better-supported read is he plays, so nothing added as an absence. Gomes/Sousa/Sanusi items are single-sourced only.

Shakhtar Donetsk.note: Ghram and Fesiun both listed out for the AEK Athens fixture by two independent same-day (14 Oct) previews: Flashscore and Sporticos. A separate Sportsmole preview omits both and instead names Irakli Azarovi and Eguinaldo out through injury -- single-sourced, not added; its predicted XI also excludes Ghram/Fesiun, consistent with them being unavailable rather than contradicting it. An earlier conflicting Squawka 'no fresh concerns' read is superseded by this two-source corroboration.

AEK Athens FC.note: Barnabas Varga (Sportsmole) and Thomas Strakosha (Flashscore) each named as sidelined through injury by one preview apiece -- single-sourced per player, not added. No two-source corroboration found for either.

Slovan Bratislava.note: Two independent previews (Sports Mole, Squawka) both report no notable absences / no fresh fitness concerns for this fixture -- a corroborated clean bill. Re-checked, no new current reports found.

VfB Stuttgart.note: Tomas: muscle injury in training per coach Sebastian Hoeneß, expected back only after the international break. Chabot (thigh) and Mittelstädt (foot/heel) both doubtful with late fitness tests pending. Sources: Stuttgarter Zeitung (Hoeneß quote), Sports Mole, buli-tipphilfe (Oct 2026). Nartey/Al-Dakhil/Jaquez single-source "out" claims not added. Re-checked, no new current reports found.
